# Süleyman Poyraz

> Open source projects and verified technical references on Linux systems programming, kernel ABIs, computer networks, and embedded hardware.

This site hosts personal technical writings and a suite of source-verified technical references built from Linux kernel sources, RFCs, IEEE specifications, and hardware datasheets.

## Technical Reference Projects

- [Linux System Call Reference](https://zaryob.github.io/syscall/): Interactive and static reference for Linux system calls across 12 processor architectures (x86_64, i386, AArch64, ARM, RISC-V 64, LoongArch 64, PowerPC 32/64, s390x, MIPS). Includes argument registers, C signatures, kernel entry points, errno, signals, and ioctl maps.
- [Pin Atlas](https://zaryob.github.io/pin-atlas/): Source-verified pinout guide and function catalog for 89 development boards and microcontrollers (Raspberry Pi, STM32, ESP32, RP2040, Arduino) covering 5,800+ physical pins.
- [Wire](https://zaryob.github.io/wire/): Bit-level packet header reference for 51 network protocols across 4 TCP/IP layers, verified against IETF RFCs and IEEE specifications (Ethernet, IPv4/v6, TCP, UDP, QUIC, BGP, TLS, etc.).
- [Execmap](https://zaryob.github.io/execmap/): Source-backed study of Linux ELF binary loading, memory layout, dynamic linking, and runtime observation via eBPF/perf/GDB.
- [Kılavuzlar](https://zaryob.github.io/kilavuzlar/): Detailed Turkish technical guides on Linux system administration, modern C++, Docker multi-arch, profiling, and virtualization.

## Key Sections & Articles

- [Projects](https://zaryob.github.io/projeler/): Full portfolio of open source software and tools.
- [All Posts](https://zaryob.github.io/posts/): Technical articles on system programming, compilers, C++, and computer science.
- [About](https://zaryob.github.io/hakkinda/): Background and contact information.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Syscall llms.txt](https://zaryob.github.io/syscall/llms.txt): Detailed index for the Linux System Call Reference.
- [Pin Atlas llms.txt](https://zaryob.github.io/pin-atlas/llms.txt): Detailed index for Pin Atlas board and MCU pinouts.
- [Wire llms.txt](https://zaryob.github.io/wire/llms.txt): Detailed index for network protocol headers.
- [Execmap llms.txt](https://zaryob.github.io/execmap/llms.txt): Detailed index for Linux binary analysis and ELF guides.
- [Kılavuzlar llms.txt](https://zaryob.github.io/kilavuzlar/llms.txt): Index for system administration and C++ guides.
